method: Separate per-key warmup process before each fresh SDK measurement; process launch excluded from SDK timing and included in CLI timing. Live and stopped profiles are sequential, not a counterbalanced comparison. Publisher readiness is sampled every 50 ms.
limitations: Resident data: each timed SDK process follows a separate per-key warmup process. Cold I/O and memory pressure are not qualified.
Live and stopped profiles are sequential and do not establish a causal performance comparison.
Forty integer keys have expected answers checked; this run is not a new exhaustive application-side 5M oracle. The publisher validates the full generation before preparation.
Process launch/dynamic loading are excluded from SDK timing. Complete CLI process wall time includes launch, shutdown and controller overhead.
steady_mean_ns=0 means no steady-loop measurement was requested.
Readiness sampling adds up to 50 ms quantization to publisher startup measurements. No universal first-read deadline is asserted.
